note: bamboo_twig_token (submodule of bamboo_twig) registers one Twig function bamboo_token(token, data={}, options={}) on service bamboo_twig_token.twig.token, wrapping \Drupal::token()->replace("[$token]", $data, $options) — pass the token WITHOUT brackets. Medium cases are live introspection (what site tokens resolve to). Hard cases have the agent write a Twig template (under web/sites/default/files/) rendered by verify: print the site name via a token (dynamic), and print the current year via a date token.

evals.prompt: How do I use bamboo_token in a Twig template, and do I include the square brackets around the token name?
evals.expected_output: bamboo_token(token, data = {}, options = {}) — pass the token WITHOUT brackets (the function adds them), e.g. {{ bamboo_token('site:name') }}.

evals.prompt: How do I resolve a node token like node:title with bamboo_token, given it needs a node object?
evals.expected_output: Pass the object in the data hash: {{ bamboo_token('node:title', {'node': node}) }}.

evals.prompt: Which option do I pass to bamboo_token to strip out any tokens that could not be replaced?
evals.expected_output: Pass {'clear': true} as the options argument, e.g. {{ bamboo_token('user:mail', {'user': user}, {'clear': true}) }}.

evals.prompt: On this live Drupal site, what string does bamboo_token('site:name') return? Run it on the running site to find out.
evals.expected_output: It returns the site name, which on this site is 'module-documentor'.

evals.prompt: On this live site, what does bamboo_token('site:url') return? Confirm against the running site.
evals.expected_output: It returns the site base URL, https://module-documentor.ddev.site/.

evals.prompt: Using bamboo_twig_token, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_token_render_sitename.html.twig whose rendered output prints this site's name via a token (do not hard-code it).
evals.expected_output: Write {{ bamboo_token('site:name') }}; rendered output equals the live site name.

evals.prompt: Using bamboo_twig_token, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_token_render_year.html.twig whose rendered output includes the current 4-digit year, produced by a Drupal date token.
evals.expected_output: Write {{ bamboo_token('current-date:custom:Y') }}; rendered output contains the current year.
